caveat: One row here is one State Level Scheme code as Tripura's own budget system numbers them. A scheme funded under more than one demand has its provisions ADDED and every demand recorded. This book covers the schemes onboarded on SNS SPARSH, which is the single-nodal-agency route through which centrally sponsored money flows, so a purely state-funded scheme outside that route does not appear here and this is a floor on Tripura's schemes rather than a count of them. The centrally sponsored schemes are published separately under centrally_sponsored_schemes, because a CSS name is the Government of India's name for a scheme and not Tripura's.

ground_truth.question: Can a person, household, farmer, student or worker receive a benefit, service, scholarship, pension, insurance or training from this line? A line for construction, an institution's running costs, administration, a census or survey, area development, or a named cost component of another scheme is not_scheme.
ground_truth.sampling: THE WHOLE CORPUS, not a sample. Tripura's book names 134 state schemes and labelling all of them costs less than designing a stratum for them, so there is no sampling error here at any threshold.

signals_rejected.signal: the word abhiyan in the name
signals_rejected.why: It looks like yojana, which measures 0.750, and it lands on the other side of the base rate. Tripura's abhiyans are Rashtriya Gram Swaraj, Swachh Bharat and Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh, and those develop a place or build a capability rather than paying anybody.

signals_rejected.signal: the Welfare of SC / ST / OBC / Tribal departments
signals_rejected.why: Below the base rate. A welfare department funds hostels and research institutes as readily as it funds scholarships, so who pays says nothing here.

signals_rejected.signal: the Public Works and Urban Development departments
signals_rejected.why: A real negative but a weak one, and every row it would catch is already caught by a word in its own name. Left out rather than double-counted.

source: Tripura Budget 2026-27, CSS & SLS Budget Overview: Details of Centrally Sponsored Schemes onboarded on SNS SPARSH, with the State Level Schemes under each

at_publish_threshold_census.what: Every line in Tripura's book carries a hand label, so this is a count over the whole population and not over a sample. There is no estimate anywhere in this file.
